rules.statement: A police officer has the right to arrest a person on a complaint of a breach of agreement if they have reasonable grounds to believe that the violating party had entertained dishonest intention.
rules.supporting_quote: If a Police officer has reasonable grounds to believe that a criminal offence had been committed by a person, he has a right under the Criminal Procedure Code to arrest the offender.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 32 (1) of the Code of Criminal Procedure Act
